figures.finding: The Eddie Garcia Act covers every worker in Philippine film and television whatever the role, directors included: a director is paid no less than the regional minimum wage (₱755 a day in Metro Manila from 26 September 2026), works 8 hours a day extendable to 14 and at most 60 a week. No directors' guild agreement, minimum fee, guaranteed period or cut right was found.

value.coverage: all workers regardless of functions, roles, positions, or status

figures.applies: Philippines, film and television workers, employees or independent contractors; the NCR wage from 26 September 2026.

sources.said: This Act applies to all workers engaged in the movie and television industry regardless of functions, roles, positions, or status. … (e) Worker refers to an employee hired by the employer or an independent contractor engaged by the principal to render services for the movie and television industry; … The minimum wage of a worker shall not be less than the applicable minimum wage in the region where the worker is hired. … The hours of work shall be eight (8) hours a day, which can be extended to a maximum of fourteen (14) hours, exclusive of meal periods. In no case shall the total number of work hours be more than sixty (60) hours in a week.
Per Wage Order No. NCR-28 … (Effective: 26 September 2026) … Non-Agriculture ₱695.00 ₱60.00 ₱755.00
